items.title: @terax/ghostty-core package: libghostty-vt WASM builds, Zig bridge, TS loaders, patches, licenses
items.rationale: ADR-003 and 5.10:2 keep the Ghostty/WASM engine; 5.4:7 forbids indiscriminate changes to the adapted WASM. Licenses (LICENSE.ghostty, LICENSE.restty) satisfy F0:2/14.3. Package name @terax/ghostty-core and TeraxGhostty* identifiers are internal (rename on touch only).
items.risks: Rebuilding the WASM needs pinned Zig 0.15.2 (FORK.md); any rename of exported symbols in terax.zig breaks the TS loader.

items.title: Renderer profiling, soak and WebKit memory scripts
items.rationale: Dev-only measurement tooling useful for 13.4 performance checks and F0:11 baseline. TERAX_* env vars and app.crynta.terax.renderer-lab are dev-script internals (macOS-only lab), not shared with an installed Terax at runtime.
items.risks: renderer-profile and webkit-memory are macOS-only (Swift/WKWebView); they will not run on the Windows dev machine.

items.title: Terminal visual/glyph regression harness
items.rationale: Glyph/sprite/scaling regression checks protect UX-005 (Nerd Fonts/powerline) and 5.4:6 (DPI). Not product UI.

items.title: Rust test validating the shipped Ghostty WASM artifacts
items.rationale: Guards the SIMD/scalar WASM split (5.4:7).

items.title: Bundled terminal symbol fonts (Nerd Fonts subset) and licenses
items.rationale: Provides powerline/Nerd glyph fallback for UX-005; OFL/Nerd Fonts licenses must ship (F0:2, 14.3:2). File names terax-terminal-symbols*.woff2 are internal asset names (rename on touch).

items.title: WebGL fallback renderer (xterm.js addon-webgl derived) and its renderer pool
items.rationale: ADR-003 / 5.10:2 / 13.5:11 require the WebGPU->WebGL fallback. MIT notice LICENSE.xterm-js + UPSTREAM.md must be preserved (14.3, F0:2).
items.risks: Window-scoped pool of 12 WebGL contexts (WebGlTerminalRuntime.ts:22); more visible panes than slots throws WebGlPoolExhaustedError.

items.title: WebGPU renderer: shared window canvas, glyph atlases, builtin sprites, geometry, scrollbar
items.rationale: 5.4:2 (one canvas per window), 5.4:7 and 5.10:2: keep without large changes. Per-pane theme is already supported by surface.setTheme; opacity/background image is a separate spike (terminal-D09).
items.risks: Canvas alphaMode 'opaque' (WebGpuWindowCanvas.ts:195,314) blocks transparency; MAX_ATLAS_COUNT=8 (WebGpuTerminalRuntime.ts:34) caps distinct font specs per window.

items.title: Ghostty model runtime: adapted model, core runtime, frame pacer, WASM probes, accessibility output
items.rationale: Persistent per-leaf model and scrollback budget (5.4, ADR-003, TER-005). TerminalAccessibleOutput is screen-reader logic (UX-010/F6:8), not a visual design element.

items.title: Semantic event router (OSC 7/133/52), presentation gates, query fallback, scrollback budget
items.rationale: Shell-integration consumers (7.3, 8.4:6 relies on prompt events) and 5.4:4/5.4:6 invariants. onTitle/onBell/onNotification exist but are not wired (see terminal-D10 for PRO-013 allowShellTitle).
couplings: backend-core/pty shell integration scripts emit the OSC sequences

items.title: Terminal link detection and activation (URLs, file paths, open in editor/reveal)
items.rationale: Detection logic stays (14.1:9 protections already present). Activation calls the editor through getLspNavigator().openFile (terminalLinks.ts:17,202) and the fs module (fs_stat/fs_canonicalize, terminalLinks.ts:179,187); 5.10:12/F2:6 make the editor optional, so file links need a fallback (OS default app / reveal) through an optional capability.
items.risks: Removing the fs backend module together with the explorer would silently break path links (errors are swallowed with .catch(() => null)).

items.title: Keyboard/IME/mouse/wheel input, key encoding, clipboard and paste helpers
items.rationale: TER-006/TER-007 and 13.2:3/13.2:4 depend on this conformance-tested input path. Configurable app shortcuts (TER-008) live in the shortcuts area, not here.

items.title: Terminal search and selection controllers
items.rationale: TER-006 (selection, search). The search UI lives in header/SearchInline.tsx (other area) and will be redesigned there.

items.title: useGhosttyTerminalSession and session lifecycle helpers (init, renderer load/fallback, presentation)
items.rationale: Core of TER-001/TER-005; must gain a launch spec (shell/args/env/cwd) instead of reading preferences.terminalShell (useGhosttyTerminalSession.ts:832-858) for PRO-011/F3:3, per-session appearance overrides for PRO-005/F3:5, a prompt-ready signal for 8.4:6, and lose its imports of spaces/workspace used only for link 'isCurrent' (useGhosttyTerminalSession.ts:2-3,730-751).
items.risks: 1.3k-line module with generation/disposal races; changes must be small and test-backed (5.4:4).

items.title: Public terminal API (index.ts, terminalSessionApi, prompt injection, surface target)
items.rationale: 6.2:2 sessions contract (leafId<->ptyId). whenSessionReady polls with a 4 s timeout and resolves on PTY/model readiness, not on a recognized prompt (terminalSessionApi.ts:25-37, useGhosttyTerminalSession.ts:412-424); 8.4:6 needs a prompt-ready contract.

items.title: openPty frontend bridge (pty_open/write/resize/close, terax-pty stream scheme)
items.rationale: openPty takes positional cwd/blocks/shell/paneId/colors (pty-bridge.ts:110-119) and has no args/env; F3:3, PRO-002, PRO-004 need a launch object. Scheme name 'terax-pty' (pty-bridge.ts:34-47) must follow whatever backend-core decides.

items.title: PTY output hub/receiver, wire format, parse scheduling, presentation classes, resize sync
items.rationale: 5.4:4 and 5.4:7 (do not modify output transport); TER-005 hidden sessions keep receiving output.

items.title: Agent activity store (terax:agent-signal listener) used by tab badges
items.rationale: 6.2:7 puts agent state in an 'agents' module and AGT-013/9.3 need provenance; this zustand store belongs to agents, not terminal. Move it (refactor) and keep the event contract.

items.title: OSC 7 cwd and OSC 52 clipboard parsers
items.rationale: 7.3 (OSC 7 on Windows paths incl. cmd/MSYS), PRJ-003 cwd tracking.

items.title: Terminal and canvas diagnostics
items.rationale: Supports F0:11/13.4 measurement; debug-only. window.__TERAX_* globals are internal.

items.title: Drop file paths into a terminal with shell quoting
items.rationale: Terminal-first convenience; quoting complies with 14.1:2. Explorer is only an optional consumer (FileExplorer.tsx:63).

items.title: Renderer backend selection (WebGPU preferred, WebGL fallback)
items.rationale: ADR-003 and 13.5:11. localStorage key 'terax.experimental.terminal-backend' (selection.ts:4) lives in the webview origin store, which is isolated once the bundle id/data dir changes (F0:10).

items.title: TerminalStack + TerminalPane (mount-forever host, visibility hiding, error/retry card)
items.rationale: 5.10:3/10.1:1-2/F1:2: keep the never-unmount lifecycle (5.4:1-3, 3.4:invariant) but depend on a minimal stack contract instead of tabs' Tab/TerminalTab (TerminalStack.tsx:1, liveTerminals.ts:1); pass a per-leaf launch/appearance spec (PRO-011, PRO-009); the error card markup (TerminalPane.tsx:166-194) is visual and gets replaced per design.

items.title: PaneTreeView (react-resizable-panels split rendering, resize handle, drop overlay)
items.rationale: Layout logic and resize-interaction gating stay (5.4:4, 13.2:7); split ratios are not modelled (no defaultSize/onLayout) so PRJ-006 needs wiring; handle and 'Drop file path here' overlay styling (PaneTreeView.tsx:126,138-145) are visual and replaced per design.

items.title: Pure split-tree helpers (panes.ts)
items.rationale: 5.10:4/6.2:4: reuse. Needs per-split ratios (PRJ-006) and per-leaf profile reference (PRO-009, PRJ-005); the leaf already carries cwd (PRJ-003).

items.title: Terminal theme builder and terminal font hook
items.rationale: Today both resolve from global preferences/CSS tokens only. PRO-005/F3:5/13.2:19 need layered resolution (global -> profile -> pane, 7.1) feeding the per-session theme/font paths that already exist.

items.title: Command-blocks mode logic (OSC 133 block model, shell line editor, completions, history)
items.rationale: User decision 3 (analysis/decisions.md): command-blocks mode is removed. (Analyst: Warp-like 'blocks' tabs are a Terax feature not required by the proposal (no TER/UX item). Keep-or-remove is a user decision (terminal-D13); until then it stays isolated (blocks tabs cannot be split, useTabs.ts:1364).)

items.title: Command-blocks visual components (BlockOverlay, BlockWatermark, ShellInput, block.css)
items.rationale: User decision 3 (analysis/decisions.md): command-blocks mode is removed. (Analyst: Purely visual Terax design (not a baseline) and imports the AI chat store for 'attach to chat' (BlockOverlay.tsx:12,265). Cut the AI dependency now (terminal-D12); remove or redesign depending on terminal-D13.)

notes: MAX_PANES_PER_TAB=4 lives in tabs (useTabs.ts:31,1365; command-palette/commands.ts:81), not here. SplitDir 'row' = side by side (split right), 'col' = stacked (split down). Sessions are module-level maps keyed by leafId (useGhosttyTerminalSession.ts), which makes moving panes between tabs (TER-009) cheap. OSC title/bell/notification events are parsed but unwired (GhosttySemanticEventRouter.ts:5-13). Inbound users of terminal APIs: tabs, spaces, control, agents, ai, explorer, command-palette, header, settings, app.
